subject: Mosaic Systems SIG RFI — evidence staging and collector checklist
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@mosaic-sys.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@mosaic-sys.com
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Mosaic SIG RFI — kick off and deadline

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for taking this on. Attached is the Mosaic SIG RFI v2 — we’ve highlighted the highest-priority control families (Access, Change Management, Logging) that need substantiation for procurement to complete the security review. Target deadline for our internal compliance review is 2027-06-21.

Can you confirm:
- A compact list of artifacts we’ll accept for each control family (preferred file types and minimum metadata)
- A short schedule for staging artifacts, a single bridge call to triage mismatches, and how you’ll handle chain-of-custody for log exports

We’re also fine with a phased delivery if you need more time for certain controls — just propose milestones.

Attached: Mosaic_SIG_RFI_v2.pdf (17 pages)

Best,
Ellen Park
Procurement Lead, Mosaic Systems
ellen.park@mosaic-sys.com
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@mosaic-sys.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mosaic SIG RFI — kick off and deadline

Hi Ellen — thanks for the RFI and the priorities. We can meet the June 21st window with a staged intake. Below is our proposed evidence staging and the collector checklist we’ll use to validate items on receipt. Please let us know if any of these acceptance criteria are blockers for you.

Plan (summary):
- Phase 1 (by 2027-06-17): Access controls and IAM artifacts — IAM policy exports, role-to-user mapping CSV, SSO configuration screenshots, sample user provisioning ticket (redacted).
- Phase 2 (by 2027-06-19): Change management — changelog exports, PR review policy, deployment runbook excerpt, test evidence pointers.
- Phase 3 (by 2027-06-21): Logging & monitoring — retention policy doc, sample aggregated logs (TLS/PII redacted), one-week access audit export.

Collector checklist (artifact naming & validation rules):
- File naming: <MOSAIC>_<control>_<yyyy-mm-dd>_<artifact-type> (e.g., MOSAIC_access_2027-06-12_iam-policy.json)
- Metadata required in each upload: source system, timestamp range, control assertion id (per SIG matrix), hash (SHA256)
- Accepted formats: .pdf, .csv, .json, .txt, .png (screenshots). For logs: .txt or compressed .gz with clear timeline header.
- Chain-of-custody: every artifact must include a short provenance note in the metadata field (who exported it, method, redaction applied). We’ll keep an intake manifest to record checksums.

Bridge call: we propose a 30-minute bridge on 2027-06-15 at 10:00am PT to triage any mapping questions and review one sample artifact per control family. If that works for you we’ll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

I’ve attached our evidence schema CSV and a sample access log export (redacted) to illustrate naming and minimal fields.

Attachments: redwood-evidence-schema.csv, svc-access-log-sample.txt

Next steps: confirm the bridge time and whether Phase 1 + Phase 2 can be delivered as two separate uploads to your intake portal.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Mosaic SIG RFI — kick off and deadline

Neha / Marissa —

Forwarding Ellen’s RFI and Neha’s plan. Action items for our side before the bridge:
- Marissa: can you prepare 2 sample artifacts for Phase 1 (IAM policy export + one user-provisioning ticket redaction) and confirm the exact path where retention metadata is stored?
- Marissa: also include the timestamp format we’ll provide so the Mosaic intake can parse times correctly.
- Neha: I’ll draft the intake manifest template and a short QA script to validate hashes and metadata on upload.

Keep this tight — we want to avoid follow-up clarifications mid-review. I’ll join the bridge on 06/15.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Security & Product Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@mosaic-sys.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@mosaic-sys.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 16:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mosaic SIG RFI — kick off and deadline

Neha, Karthik — thank you, this is exactly the level of detail we were hoping for. 06/15 10:00am PT works for the bridge. A few quick clarifications before the call: 

- For chain-of-custody, would you accept a simple SHA256 checksum in the manifest, or do you require signed attestations? SHA alone is fine for our procurement review, but security will ask about attestations later.
- On logs: can you confirm redaction policy — we need assurance that any exported logs remove full PII and jurisdictional identifiers. A short redaction template would be helpful.

We’ll upload a small sample artifact set to the intake link once Neha sends the Drive invite. Procurement will run the first pass and flag anything that needs a second look.

Appreciate the quick turn — see you on Wednesday.

Best,
Ellen

On the bridge: please include the intake link in the invite and the expected file size limits so our team can compress appropriately.

--
Ellen Park
Procurement Lead, Mosaic Systems
On Wed, Jun 15, 2027 at 10:00am PT Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Bridge call recap (notes):
> - Acceptance: SHA256 in the manifest is acceptable for initial intake; signed attestations are optional but helpful for higher-risk controls.
> - Redaction: Redwood will provide a 3-line redaction template (what to remove, how to mask, and required metadata).
> - Upload window: Mosaic to provide Phase 1 artifacts by EOD 2027-06-17.
> - Action items: Marissa to upload sample IAM export + provisioning ticket before 06/16; Karthik to share manifest template; Neha to post Drive invite and intake link.
